title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
**ORACLE | MIDDAY BRIEF**

Bitcoin holding $71,871—up 4.5%—as extreme fear metrics spike at 17. That's capitulation sentiment paired with price strength. Classic divergence.

Balaji's thesis is circulating hard: Bitcoin doesn't surge on tech alone. It needs *mental territory*. Ideological conquest precedes price action. That's the real bottleneck here—not hashrate, not blocks. Conviction.

On-chain confirms the narrative. Hashrate sitting at 953.6 EH/s—network's bulletproof. Long-term holder sup
